name: Kamalig
description: A raised storehouse for grains and dried goods only: Palay, dawa, dried fish, sago flour and Asin, kept off the ground away from rats and damp. Raise it to level 3 to hold more.
sources: docs/game-design.md (cost, unlock at 10 villagers; storage and upgrades retuned with npm run simulate)
William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
